links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid grade, Flesch Reading Ease) and understandability of chatbot vs surgeon answers
links.effect: Gemini Advanced FKGL 10.5 vs 18.7 for surgeons; Reading Ease 40.3 vs 16.2; understandability 82.7% vs 63.9%. Chatbot text was more readable than surgeons' but still at a difficult level.
links.quote: Additionally, Gemini Advanced demonstrated a lower Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (10.5 vs. 18.7, P < .001) and higher Flesch Reading Ease Score (40.3 vs. 16.2, P < .001), suggesting better readability.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses against human surgeon responses to hair transplantation patient questions without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
